title: Zesty Herbal French Mushroom Quiche
description: A dairy-free friendly, herbal French quiche featuring peppercorns and mushrooms, cooked to perfection in a clay pot kazan cauldron. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the sliced mushrooms until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the freshly ground peppercorns and cook for an additional minute.
Roll out the quiche crust and place it in the kazan cauldron or a similar clay pot.
Fill the quiche crust with the mushroom and onion mixture, and top with crumbled tofu.
Cover the kazan cauldron with a lid and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
